licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics, words and slurs, then checked bar by bar by two fresh checkers (one error found, a left-hand tie in bars 20–21, and one incomplete tie in bar 43, both corrected). The German singing translation is left out. Bar 1 is a one-eighth upbeat, set as 1/8; bars 89–93 are for the piano alone. A printed slur that crosses from the right hand into the left hand's middle voice (bars 41–42 and 44–45) is written in the left hand only. Playback tempo: ♩ = 60 in 2/4, and a dotted quarter = 72 (♩ = 108) in 6/8 from bar 25, set so the whole matches Rattle (2:46) and Klemperer (3:11); Mozart gives the word Allegretto only.
